observed_text: Lowering the free-electron density until the optical plasma edge drops through the visible should also inflate the RF skin depth in the same sample.
implied_text: Optical R and RF δ are two clocks on one carrier density. Starve n and both envelopes move together.
description: One n moves the optical edge and the classical skin depth together.
value_text: same n for R(ω) and δ(ω)
notes: Does not claim optical penetration equals √(2/ωμσ). Checked 2026-11-11: the trend is established in transparent conducting oxides (sputtered ITO with n = 3.76–9.42e20 cm⁻³ has its plasma wavelength at 2180–1378 nm and a resistivity about 110–130 times copper, so a skin depth about 11 times copper's; Askari et al., arXiv:1409.5293). No opened source measured RF skin depth and the plasma edge on one sample while n was varied. The claim is incomplete as worded: δ follows σ = neμ while the edge follows n/m*, so mobility is a second knob (Bi et al., arXiv:2310.00984).

observed_text: Faraday rotation through a metal film thin enough to transmit should change smoothly as the carrier crosses the film's plasma edge, with no collapse at the edge. Above the edge it should fall as 1/ω², the law measured in plasmas at 11–200 times their plasma frequency.
implied_text: The rotation needs a propagating wave in a magnetized free-electron population. The plasma edge is where propagation begins, not where the rotation ends.
description: Faraday rotation in a free-electron medium fades smoothly above the plasma edge.
notes: Reworded 2026-11-11. The first wording, 'rotation collapses where the medium goes plasma-transparent', was contradicted for a plasma: ionospheric and interstellar rotation is measured at 100–200 MHz against a plasma frequency of 1–9 MHz and follows λ² (faraday-rotation [S4]; fact row faraday-rotation:failure_mode:verdet-gone). Below the edge the wave does not propagate at all. Untested part: no measurement through a metal film across its plasma edge was found.

observed_text: A superparamagnetic grain should show no static saturation magnetostriction on laboratory time. Any λ would average toward zero with M.
implied_text: Static ΔL is locked to a held M. No held M ⇒ no static λs.
description: The strain channel dies with the latch cell.
notes: Dynamic / RMS magnetostriction is not this claim. Checked 2026-11-11: not checkable as worded, and the reasoning is doubtful. Joule magnetostriction goes as cos²θ, so it is even in M: a moment flipping between the two directions of one easy axis keeps its strain, and 'λ averages to zero with M' does not follow. No measurement on unblocked Ni was found. The value 2.3e-26 m³ is the NdFeB volume; for Ni the 25 kT volume is about 2.1e-23 m³ (34 nm).

observed_text: Shapiro steps should persist when the drive frequency exceeds the gap frequency 2Δ/h of the electrodes (85 GHz for Al, 735 GHz for Nb). The step amplitude should peak at the gap frequency and fall above it, with the ratio 2e/h unchanged.
implied_text: The gap frequency limits the amplitude of the pair current. It does not limit the voltage–frequency ratio.
description: The V–ν lock survives above the gap frequency with reduced amplitude.
notes: Reworded 2026-11-11. The first wording, 'the lock washes out once ν ≳ 2Δ/h', was contradicted as a cutoff by the Werthamer–Riedel calculation: the supercurrent peaks at the gap frequency and steps are calculated to exist up to terahertz frequencies (josephson-effect [S4], read as an abstract; fact row josephson-effect:failure_mode:above-gap-frequency). Marked untested because that support is a model result and no measurement of steps above the gap frequency was opened.

observed_text: A dilute alkali BEC should not produce a thermomechanical fountain or a superleak viscosity collapse of the He-4 kind.
implied_text: Fountain / superleak need a dense two-fluid ρs. Phase-space condensation is not that hardware.
description: Dilute BEC is not chargeless-superflow in disguise.
notes: Conjecture from chargeless-superflow downward. Checked 2026-11-11: the fountain half is untested (no such experiment found). The implied 'no superflow' is contradicted: dilute condensates show a critical velocity (Raman et al. 1999) and persistent flow for 10 s (Ryu et al. 2007). Reword before relying on it.

observed_text: A Poisson shot-noise floor that survives T → 0 at finite current is not the Nyquist / Brownian thermal average.
implied_text: Shot noise is a count-of-events machine. Johnson–Nyquist is an ensemble average. Collapsing one should not be sold as collapsing the other.
description: Shot noise is a different machine and is not yet in the library.
notes: No effect file. effect_slug left null on purpose. Candidate tenth-adjacent artifact not a new design yet. Checked 2026-11-11: not checkable: a definitional exclusion. Shot noise follows from charge quantization and needs a current.

observed_text: χ = C/T cannot be used as the energy barrier of a permanent-magnet latch. The unlocked ensemble is the population the latch replaces.
implied_text: If a mapping treats Curie χ as the latch barrier the anisotropy-latch design is in tension.
description: Unlocked χ is incompatible with a held directional state.
notes: Pairs with the extracted unlocked-no-latch row. Kept as a named downward exclusion. Checked 2026-11-11: not checkable, because it is a rule about the mapping and not an observation. The fact behind it is measured: a paramagnetic salt follows a reversible Brillouin curve with no remanence (Henry, Phys. Rev. 88, 559 (1952)).

observed_text: On a given metal the work function φ and the optical plasma / interband edge must not be required to coincide. A sample can be lit below φ and below the edge (it reflects and emits no electrons) or in other combinations.
implied_text: Two gates on one surface. Identifying them collapses two designs into one number.
description: φ is not ωp.
value_text: φ ≠ ωp (Ag 4.33 eV vs 3.92 eV edge)
notes: Library already warns. This row is the screening engine forbidding the identification. Checked 2026-11-11: not checkable: a definitional exclusion. For reference, Ag has a polycrystalline work function of 4.33 eV and a reflectance minimum at 3.92 eV.

observed_text: Integer QHE plateaus should not be readable as a superconducting pairing gap or as a Meissner expulsion. The hardware is a 2DEG plus Landau levels plus an edge channel.
implied_text: If this claim is forced into gapped-condensate the design is over-stretched. Leave QHE unmapped as a member until it owns its own machine.
description: QHE is not the charged pairing condensate.
notes: Why QHE stayed off implication_design. Predicted as an incompatibility not as a tenth design. Checked 2026-11-11: not checkable: a definitional exclusion.

observed_text: Liquid 4He below Tλ should not expel magnetic field or show χ = −1 of the Meissner kind.
implied_text: No charge ⇒ no London λ ⇒ no electromagnetic expulsion. Circulation is not screening.
description: Chargeless superflow does not do Meissner.
notes: Downward from chargeless-superflow. A charged-superfluid analog would be a different machine. Checked 2026-11-11: not checkable: definitional, helium-4 carries no charge.

observed_text: A muon-free hydride cell (Pd–D or Ni–H pulsed coil with no muon source) should not emit the μCF cycle: no ~100–150 dt fusions per stopped muon and no catalysis that dies with τμ or sticking.
implied_text: This gate requires the muon node. Lattice strain and defect inventory are not substitutes. Cosmic-ray flux does not track bake-out or cold work.
description: A muon-free cell is not this machine.
notes: Downward from energy-gate. Bounds EM-LENR: isolate the latch; do not file that cell as μCF. Checked 2026-11-11: not checkable, because it is definitional. The cycle is defined by a stopped muon, and no source reports a search in a muon-free cell. The record is about 150 fusions per muon.

observed_text: A 2D topological-insulator helical edge (QSHE) or a magnetically gapped Chern-insulator edge (QAHE) that shows a quantized conductance plateau without a perpendicular-field Landau ladder would share the edge-path stack but not the integer-QHE clock. Either should be added as a second core member of edge-channel rather than forced into integer QHE or into QPC.
implied_text: If this cousin is folded into the integer-QHE B-opened ladder the design is over-stretched. File it first; then promote edge-channel from draft.
description: QSHE / QAHE are cousins not yet in the library.
value_text: helical or Chern edge; no Landau ladder
notes: effect_slug left null on purpose. Upgrade trigger for formal status. Do not mint a second predicted cousin row. Checked 2026-11-11: not checkable: a filing rule, not a physical claim.

observed_text: A dilute alkali BEC should not expel magnetic field or show χ = −1 of the Meissner kind, and it should not present a London λ.
implied_text: Phase-space condensation is chargeless and has no pairing condensate. Circulation or vortices in the cloud are not electromagnetic screening.
description: Dilute BEC is not a London superconductor.
notes: Twin of predicted:meissner:no-expulsion-in-he4 from the dilute-cloud side. Checked 2026-11-11: not checkable: definitional, the atoms are neutral.

observed_text: In a 2DEG that can host both a cyclotron line and integer Hall plateaus, walking the microwave drive off ωc should kill the absorption line without moving RH off RK/ν. Walking B off a plateau should kill the flat RH without requiring the microwave line to be the collapse.
implied_text: Same eB/m combination; different output. CR is a clock-match absorption; QHE is a DC edge-channel plateau.
description: The cyclotron line is not the Hall plateau.
notes: Downward from edge-channel. Uses the existing CR ↔ QHE related-entry split. Checked 2026-11-11: not checkable, because it is a definitional exclusion. No opened source varies the microwave drive and the Hall plateau in one device. Note that in a 2D sheet the collective line sits at ω² = ωp² + ωc², so the line gives the mass only after that correction.

observed_text: The resistance h/e², which the tunnel barriers of an island must exceed by a wide margin for N to stay integer, should not appear as a Hall plateau at RK/ν with Rxx→0. A blockaded island is not a metrological Hall bar.
implied_text: Same h/e² bricks. On the island it is an order-of-magnitude condition for charge quantization; in the Hall bar it is an edge-channel output.
description: RQ is not a Hall quantum.
notes: Promotes coulomb-blockade:consistency_gap:rq-not-hall to a design commitment. Twin of predicted:photoelectric-threshold:not-the-plasma-edge. Checked 2026-11-11: not checkable: definitional. The two are the same constant, and Rt ≫ h/e² is an order-of-magnitude condition, not a floor.

observed_text: A 2.224 MeV photon on deuterium should unbind d → p+n and should not start a muon-catalyzed cycle: no ~100–150 dt fusions per stopped muon, and the yield should not die with τμ or α-sticking.
implied_text: Opposite arrow on the same two nucleons. The unbinding gate is a photon plus a deuteron; the fusion-direction gate needs a muon.
description: A photodisintegration photon is not a muon catalyst.
notes: Downward from energy-gate. Complements predicted:muon-catalyzed-fusion:muon-free-cell-is-null. Checked 2026-11-11: not checkable, because it is definitional. The threshold including recoil is 2.2259 MeV, so read '2.224 MeV photon' as a photon above that.

observed_text: On a given island the charging energy Ec = e²/2C should not be required to equal the work function φ of the leads. Changing lead φ (or the photoelectric threshold of the same metal) should not be sold as moving the diamond period.
implied_text: One design, two gates. Ec is electrostatic; φ is a surface unbinding. Identifying them collapses the charging island into the photoelectric face.
description: Ec is not φ.
notes: Twin of predicted:photoelectric-threshold:not-the-plasma-edge, inside energy-gate. Checked 2026-11-11: not checkable: definitional. The charging energy is set by capacitance (80 µeV at 1 fF).

observed_text: A CEνNS target exposed to neutrinos well below the 1.8 MeV inverse-beta-decay threshold should still produce N² recoils while qR ≪ 1. The IBD channel staying shut is not this collapse.
implied_text: The operating window is the coherence condition, not a rest-mass or charged-current gate. A large rate step at 1.8 MeV on the same nucleus would be a different machine.
description: CEνNS does not turn on at the IBD threshold.
value_text: Eν < 1.8 MeV still CEνNS if qR≪1
notes: Same-sample commitment. Extracted rows already say there is no IBD gate; this row is the would-be observation. Checked 2026-11-11: untested. Reactor CEνNS is now observed (CONUS+ 2025, 3.7σ), but a 1.8 MeV neutrino gives germanium at most 96 eV against a 160 eV detector threshold, so no detected recoil yet comes from below the inverse-beta threshold.

observed_text: A pyroelectric D–D cell whose host is taken through its ferroelectric Tc (LiTaO3 ~890 K) should lose the accelerating potential and the 2.45 MeV neutron burst even if deuterium is still present.
implied_text: The polar latch writes the field. Above Tc the field engine is gone; the nuclear gate has nothing to open it.
description: Pyroelectric fusion dies with the polar host.
notes: Downward from polar-latch. Twin of piezoelectricity:failure_mode:ferroelectric-tc. Ordinary ramps stay far below this cliff. Checked 2026-11-11: untested. No experiment taking a pyroelectric fusion cell through its Curie point was found. The LiTaO3 Curie temperature is reported from 874 to 958 K depending on composition, so '~890 K' should be read as that range.

observed_text: A plate whose metal face is islanded, below percolation, should still attract. The force should be lower than for a continuous film and set by the infrared response of the face near c/2d; it should not fall to zero.
implied_text: Casimir contrast follows the response of the faces around the gap frequency c/2d. Poorer screening lowers the force continuously.
description: Islanded faces reduce the Casimir force; they do not remove it.
value_text: sub-percolation face: reduced force, not zero
notes: Reworded 2026-11-11. The first wording, 'islanded or visibly transparent faces give no conducting-plate attraction', was contradicted for transparent faces: indium tin oxide gives about 40–50 % less force than gold at 50–150 nm (casimir-force [S8]); a mirror switched to transparent gave no measurable change at 70–400 nm ([S9]); a continuous 9.2 nm Pd film gives a reduced force ([S7]). Fact rows: casimir-force:hardware_scale:gap and casimir-force:clock_latency:cavity-mode. Untested part: no Casimir measurement on a sub-percolation film was found.
